title: LP GRS 5° Compound & Elemental Abundance (Prettyman et al. 2006)
description: Global lunar abundance maps of MgO, Al2O3, SiO2, CaO, TiO2, FeO, K, Th, and U at 5° quasi-equal-area resolution (~1790 pixels, ~150 km). Derived by linear spectral unmixing of Lunar Prospector gamma ray spectra, high-altitude (HIGH1, ~100 km) data set, by Prettyman et al. (2006). Oxides in wt%, K/Th/U in ppm.
